description: This file defines an interface 'ILocalSiloDetails' that describes the details and properties of a local silo within the Orleans distributed system runtime.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Property to get the name of the silo.

methods.name: ClusterId
methods.description: Property to get the cluster identity or deployment ID of the silo.

methods.name: DnsHostName
methods.description: Property to get the DNS hostname of the silo, usually matching DNS.GetHostName().

methods.name: SiloAddress
methods.description: Property to get the silo's inter-silo communication address.

methods.name: GatewayAddress
methods.description: Property to get the silo's gateway proxy endpoint address.
